Gifted Manipuri musician beaten to death for objecting to noise outside Delhi home
articles.summary: Chongtham Vikram Singh, a gifted guitarist, died after being beaten outside his home. He had gone to stop intoxicated men creating a disturbance near his residence.

Global Chess League: Viswanathan Anand loses to Carlsen on time; calls it 'a pity'
articles.summary: Magnus Carlsen edged Viswanathan Anand in a dramatic time scramble on Day 3 of the Global Chess League, with Anand losing on time despite his team securing victory. Carlsen later drew Javokhir Sindarov after unleashing the surprise 3...f6.

articles.title: SA Chandrasekhar’s praises son and CM Vijay for handling pressure with ease
articles.summary: Filmmaker SA Chandrasekhar expressed immense pride as he met his son, Vijay, who now serves as Chief Minister. He commended Vijay for gracefully navigating the complexities of political life.

articles.title: 'Bridgerton' star Phoebe Dynevor weds Cameron Fuller in France
articles.summary: Actress Phoebe Dynevor and producer Cameron Fuller reportedly married in France. The couple exchanged vows at an 18th-century farmhouse surrounded by loved ones.

articles.title: Original cast confirmed to return for upcoming movie ‘The Inbetweeners 3'
articles.summary: Excitement is in the air as the original cast of The Inbetweeners gears up for their much-anticipated return in a new movie, set to hit screens worldwide via an OTT platform. Production starts next Monday, with creators Damon Beesley and Iain Morris back at the helm.

articles.title: Parvathy Thiruvothu blames celebrity silence during student protests
articles.summary: Parvathy Thiruvothu emphasizes the importance of film celebrities standing by the youth during tough times. She argues that artists should not be passive while facing serious challenges.
